title: Graph tutorial
scope: Inline GML and explicit calls to Algorithms 1 and 2.

title: ABA: growing paths
scope: Typed-path ABA model with an optional missing-edge gate. Polynomial jump closure does not imply a finite expectation ODE.

title: Molecular ROP
scope: Atom-resolved lactone ROP with the ABA query and no gate. The existing constructor language and counting assumptions are part of the backend.

title: TCS: aldol composition
scope: Conditional aldol composition; selected local overlap, not closure or a full chemical CTMC.

title: Chlorination with a NAC
scope: Single-site chlorination with and without the neighbour NAC, on the unbounded-tail family.

title: Rémy trees
scope: Rooted planar trees; DPO projection with the checked valid-tree counting reduction.

title: Eight sites
scope: Fresh symbolic synthesis for eight sites, with connected and disconnected topologies.

title: DNA walker
scope: Fresh closure synthesis from the four original graph rules and one query.

title: ABA: five queries
scope: Five motifs with fixed ungated typed-path rules and explicit search budgets.

title: FRAGGER comparison
scope: Read retained A/B benchmark measurements. This does not rerun either benchmark or establish equality of all composite expressions.

title: Brusselator–ROP
scope: Exact event analysis. Oscillatory macroscopic dynamics in the full notebook are a separate approximation.

title: Growing ring
scope: Bounded exact search on an unbounded ring language. A budget stop is not a non-closure proof; R1 dynamics are a separate approximation.
